name: View Entity Render Popup
description: A field formatter that displays entity-reference targets in a modal popup.
project_description:
The View Entity Render Popup will help to render the Entity reference field value in modal popup. We can able to specify the Viewmode of Entity to display.

 Features 
 
 Views entity reference field will be shown as a Modal 
 Additional Field formatted for Views 
 Flexibility to choose the Viewmode for Entity 
 Entity view link can be editable 
 
 Post-Installation 
 This module requires no modules outside of Drupal core Views and Field. There is no specific configuration for the Module.
